answer_2.quote: Accuracy and macro-averaged F1 score are used as metrics.

answer_3.quote: We include GPT-4 evaluation as performance ceiling where we explicitly declare the gender, age, or ethnicity of speakers coupled with transcripts and Level-1 prompts.
methods: performance ceiling evaluation with explicit speaker information

answer_4.quote: All samples (262 samples) were further filtered by three human annotators to maintain quality, resulting in 180 final transcriptions. Three human annotators are all from our co-authors of this paper (2 faculty members and 1 PhD student, all with expertises in NLP).
answer_4.guideline: The annotators work independently and do not have access to each other's annotation results during the process to avoid undesired biases. A sample is removed if at least two annotators find it low quality.
